meta.semantics: DT direct-thiscall receiver origin equivalence edges over direct call sites in decompile-results/full_export snapshot. For each resolved direct `call FN2` with FN2 in signals.json and fn_takes_this.json==True (fallback signals cc==thiscall): backward <=8-instr window (barriers: jump-target label, unconditional jmp/ret, any call, first ecx writer) finds the ecx setup. mov ecx,[base+off] with base->FN1 this (entry-ecx pass-through, <=3 copy hops, undef-since-entry) => T:FN2 == M:FN1:this:0xOFF (form=mem). lea ecx,[base+off] same => form=lea (embedded member object, vrorg interior convention). mov ecx,offset G / ds:G / pattern-global / named-global-in-signals => T:FN2 == G:ADDR. mov ecx,eax with nearest eax def = call => T:FN2 == EAX:FN1:CALLSITE. [ebp+X]/[ebp+arg_N] skipped (PF param_forward_edges R3 territory; overlap counted vs PF T-edge sites). Nested member chains (this->a->b), esp/ebp bases, off==0, scaled operands, pure-reg copies (incl. this forwarding) and multi-hop eax skipped. Entities: T:%X M:%X:this:0x%X EAX:%X:%X G:%X (uppercase hex); sites 0x%x lowercase. Each site emits at most one edge.
